note: Assignment of every tests/Feature top-level group to a CI lane, an exclusion, or a deferral. Enforced by tools/feature-lane-manifest-check.php, which runs as a discrete step in the backend-architecture job (no `if:` guard, in all-checks-pass `needs`). A new directory has no entry here and FAILS the check - that is the whole point: before this file, a new Feature class in an unlisted directory ran nowhere, forever, and nothing said so. `classes` is an ENFORCED non-growth CEILING for `deferred`/`excluded` groups: such a group may shrink freely and may NEVER grow, so a new class there fails CI until the ceiling is raised deliberately or the group is laned. It is NOT documentation.

dispositions.lane: Runs automatically in the named CI lane. New classes in the group are picked up with no edit here.
dispositions.excluded: Genuinely cannot run in CI (needs a device, an external service, a manual fixture). Requires `reason`.
dispositions.deferred: CAN run, but no lane runs it yet; blocked on the F-2 CI-budget decision. Requires `reason`. Counted loudly on every CI run.

security-regression.events_note: EVERY event that starts the workflow — PR->dev, PR->main, push->main, workflow_dispatch. The job has NO `if:` guard, by the parent ruling of 2026-08-19 on brief F-2's sub-decision. It was previously a step inside the `if:`-gated backend-test job and therefore did not run on PR->dev.
security-regression.note: Whole directory, not a filter list, so new classes are gated the moment they land.

treasury-spine-pgsql/feature-treasury.note: Real Postgres: the forbid-balance-write trigger, repository_movements immutability, GL advisory locks and savepoints all markTestSkipped on sqlite.

treasury-spine-pgsql/feature-accounting.note: Same PG rationale as the Treasury directory.
